# Vineet Vijay

> Vineet Vijay is a digital marketing strategist based in Dubai, United Arab Emirates, with ten years in healthcare, e-commerce, FMCG and luxury marketing across the UAE and India. This site publishes his practitioner essays on AI search visibility, schema markup, SEO and paid media, and free llms.txt generators and UTM builders for marketers.

- Type: Personal website and publication
- Based: Dubai, United Arab Emirates
- Markets: UAE, Saudi Arabia, India and the wider GCC
- Current role: Senior Digital Marketing Manager at House of Comms, Dubai (since April 2026)
- Previously: Reem Hospital, Wavemaker (WPP), Interactive Avenues (IPG)
- Topics: AI search visibility (AEO and GEO), schema markup, SEO, paid media, measurement
- Quoting: welcome with attribution and a link to the original essay

## About

- [Experience](https://vineetonmarketing.com/experience/): Vineet Vijay, digital marketing specialist in Dubai: roles, results, education, skills and the work he takes on, from ten years in digital marketing across the UAE and India.
- [Contact](https://vineetonmarketing.com/contact/): Email, phone and a contact form for advisory, speaking and podcast enquiries.

## Essays

- [On-page SEO: every element has one job. Know which](https://vineetonmarketing.com/on-page-seo/): On-page SEO sorted by job: the Rank, Click, Quote framework, a map of every on-page element to the job it does, how to tell from Search Console which job is failing, and a ten-question checklist.
- [What is SEO? A simple guide for everyone](https://vineetonmarketing.com/what-is-seo/): What SEO is in plain language, how crawling, indexing and ranking work, the Four-Question Test (Find, Understand, Trust, Choose), SEO versus paid ads, how long SEO takes, and where to start this week.
- [What is an AI visibility score? And what's actually worth measuring](https://vineetonmarketing.com/ai-visibility-score/): What an AI visibility score measures, why three tools gave one hospital three different scores, why scores change from run to run, and the PACE check (Presence, Accuracy, Citations, Effect).
- [Snapchat advertising in the UAE works for some brands. Here's how to tell if it's yours](https://vineetonmarketing.com/snapchat-advertising-uae/): Snapchat advertising in the UAE: what the public evidence shows for Sponsored Snaps, takeovers, lead forms, automation and Lenses, how to read a platform case study, and a five-point fit test.
- [Digital marketing for doctors: how I built the plan from zero](https://vineetonmarketing.com/digital-marketing-for-doctors/): A five-step plan for digital marketing for surgeons and doctors that starts at the booked appointment, with a plastic surgery department case from Reem Hospital.
- [What is sameAs schema? A plain-English guide for marketers](https://vineetonmarketing.com/sameas-schema/): What sameAs markup is, who needs it, when to use it and how to add it without writing code.
- [How to rank in AI Overviews: what I learned getting cited](https://vineetonmarketing.com/rank-in-ai-overviews/): How a hospital website with a domain authority of 17 was cited in Google AI Overviews, and the LIFT test for writing passages AI answers can quote.
- [Schema markup for real estate: seven schemas every property site needs](https://vineetonmarketing.com/schema-markup-for-real-estate/): The seven Schema.org types a real estate developer website needs, villa category page schema, a worked example and a brief for the development team.
- [Schema markup is your website's resume](https://vineetonmarketing.com/schema-markup-ai-visibility/): A five-line framework for schema markup that helps search engines and AI tools identify a person or business correctly.
- [Customer Match IP address matching: Google Ads just learned to read your server logs](https://vineetonmarketing.com/customer-match-ip-timestamp/): What Google Ads Customer Match matching on IP address and timestamp means for match rates, and the consent steps to take first.

## Free tools

- [AI Tools](https://vineetonmarketing.com/ai-tools/): Free tools for marketers that run in the browser.
- [llms.txt Generator](https://vineetonmarketing.com/ai-tools/llms-txt-generator/): What llms.txt is, why it matters for AI visibility, and industry-specific generators that build the file.
- [llms.txt generator for real estate](https://vineetonmarketing.com/ai-tools/llms-txt-generator/real-estate/): For property developers, brokerages, agencies and portals.
- [llms.txt generator for healthcare](https://vineetonmarketing.com/ai-tools/llms-txt-generator/healthcare/): For hospitals, clinics and specialists.
- [llms.txt generator for e-commerce](https://vineetonmarketing.com/ai-tools/llms-txt-generator/ecommerce/): For D2C brands, retailers and marketplaces.
- [llms.txt generator for education](https://vineetonmarketing.com/ai-tools/llms-txt-generator/education/): For universities, schools, institutes and learning platforms.
- [llms.txt generator for finance and fintech](https://vineetonmarketing.com/ai-tools/llms-txt-generator/finance/): For banks, payments, lending, insurance and investment firms.
- [llms.txt generator for publishers](https://vineetonmarketing.com/ai-tools/llms-txt-generator/publishers/): For news sites, magazines, blogs and newsletters.
- [UTM Builder](https://vineetonmarketing.com/ai-tools/utm-builder/): Builds UTM links, predicts the GA4 default channel each link reports under, and checks for naming mistakes.
- [UTM builder for healthcare](https://vineetonmarketing.com/ai-tools/utm-builder/healthcare/): For hospitals and clinics, with a service line and objective naming convention.
- [UTM builder for ecommerce](https://vineetonmarketing.com/ai-tools/utm-builder/ecommerce/): For online stores, including Shopping, email flows and creators.
- [UTM builder for real estate](https://vineetonmarketing.com/ai-tools/utm-builder/real-estate/): For property developers and brokers, by project and objective.
- [UTM builder for travel and tourism](https://vineetonmarketing.com/ai-tools/utm-builder/travel-tourism/): For hotels, tour operators and destinations.
- [UTM builder for B2B](https://vineetonmarketing.com/ai-tools/utm-builder/b2b/): For B2B and SaaS teams, by product, offer and funnel stage.
